Comment: Stock Data Pipeline with Parallel Processing per Stock

PrepareStockList.Comment: Prepare list of stocks to process

ProcessStocksInParallel.Comment: Process each stock in parallel (up to 9 concurrent executions)

FetchSingleStock.Comment: Fetch data for a single stock from APIs to SQLite

MarkStockSuccess.Comment: Mark this stock as successfully processed

AggregateResults.Comment: Aggregate results from all stocks and prepare for RDS ingestion

CheckAggregateStatus.Comment: Check if we have minimum data to proceed to RDS

IngestToRDS.Comment: Ingest all stock data from SQLite to RDS

Parameters.Subject: ✅ Stock Data Pipeline - SUCCESS (Parallel Processing)
❌ Stock Data Pipeline - RDS INGESTION FAILED
Parameters.Message.$:
States.Format('❌ RDS ingestion failed

✅ Stock Fetch: {} successful, {} failed
❌ RDS Ingestion: FAILED

Error: {}

Execution ID: {}', $.aggregated.successful_count, $.aggregated.failed_count, $.error.Cause, $$.Execution.Name)

Parameters.Subject: ❌ Stock Data Pipeline - COMPLETE FAILURE
Parameters.Message.$:
States.Format('❌ Pipeline failed completely

All {} stocks failed to fetch data.

Execution ID: {}', $.aggregated.total_stocks, $$.Execution.Name)
